routeLazyImpactLabel: Route Lazy Boundary Safe, But Bundle Size Mostly Unchanged
productionDecision: Patch 7 safely added a lazy route boundary for ExchangeRoutes and the build passed. The largest chunks did not meaningfully reduce, so the next step should audit App.jsx and ExchangeLayout.jsx before touching core map internals.
interpretation: ExchangeRoutes.jsx lazy boundary was applied and detected successfully.
The pages JS chunk did not meaningfully decrease after lazy-loading ExchangeLayout.
The vendor-map chunk did not meaningfully decrease after lazy-loading ExchangeLayout.
This suggests another static import path, nested Exchange layout import, or Vite chunk grouping still keeps heavy code in large shared chunks.
The safest next inspection targets are App.jsx and ExchangeLayout.jsx, before editing SHSOperationalMapboxMap.jsx.
